name: Hugging Face Inference Endpoints on AWS
description: Research snapshot scoped to AWS endpoints; excludes other provider offerings and does not assert a GPU-by-region matrix.

provenance.notes: AWS portion of documented endpoint regions only. Service is managed; host operating-system access is not exposed.
AWS private endpoints support intra-region PrivateLink. Actual endpoint/network setup remains a deployment check.
Dedicated replica compute is metered; L4 rate does not prove availability in either region.
